name: Mailtrain
description: Self-hosted newsletter application with rich templates, segmentation, and built-in Zone-MTA delivery.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      PORT_TRUSTED: {{env.PORT_TRUSTED}}
      PORT_SANDBOX: {{env.PORT_SANDBOX}}
      PORT_PUBLIC: {{env.PORT_PUBLIC}}
      URL_BASE_TRUSTED: {{env.URL_BASE_TRUSTED}}
      URL_BASE_SANDBOX: {{env.URL_BASE_SANDBOX}}
      URL_BASE_PUBLIC: {{env.URL_BASE_PUBLIC}}
      MYSQL_HOST: {{serviceName}}-db
      MYSQL_USER: mailtrain
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: {{env.MYSQL_PASSWORD}}
      MYSQL_DATABASE: mailtrain
      MONGO_HOST: {{serviceName}}-mongo
      REDIS_HOST: {{serviceName}}-redis
      WWW_SECRET: {{env.WWW_SECRET}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}:/app/data
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-db
      - {{serviceName}}-mongo
      - {{serviceName}}-redis
  {{serviceName}}-db:
    image: mariadb:10
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-db
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: {{env.MYSQL_PASSWORD}}
      MYSQL_USER: mailtrain
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: {{env.MYSQL_PASSWORD}}
      MYSQL_DATABASE: mailtrain
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/mysql:/var/lib/mysql
  {{serviceName}}-mongo:
    image: mongo:6
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-mongo
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/mongo:/data/db
  {{serviceName}}-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
